title: Software
text: I develop R packages. Source is on GitHub; most are on CRAN and r-universe.

title: Software
text:
Japanese official statistics & geospatial data

jpstat — tools for easy use of the e-Stat API
jpgrid — functions for the Grid Square Codes (JIS X 0410)
jpcity — read and convert Japanese municipality codes

title: Software
text:
Data structures & tooling

timbr — forest / tree data frames
dibble — dimensional data frames
navigatr — navigation menu for pipe-friendly data processing
tarchives — make your targets pipelines into a package
adverbial — enhanced partialised and composed functions
stickyr — data frames with persistent columns and attributes

title: Software
text:
Economics

econagent — utility functions and composite goods in economics
econio — input–output analysis
econiodatajp — ready-to-use Japanese input–output tables
ndgras — the nD-GRAS method (a multidimensional extension of RAS)
econioread — read input–output tables
